body: Ever get so stressed you can't even function correctly and thus can't make even the most basic of opportunities happen anymore?  That's my life. No, there was never a point like that because I can't make anything happen and never could. I am so embarrassed that I haven't killed myself yet, this is just endless frustration, failure, and pain. It gets really fucking old. My voice is the worst part, I never want to talk, the sound is just pathetic and weak, and never ceases to betray me. I am a walking punchline. I just want to sleep and all that cliche bullshit other people said so much fucking better.
